scope: All 204 acquired Jalpaiguri 2023 Form A pages in nine source PDFs; every page visually inspected.
rotation_policy: Use only the exact source SHA/page key; verify the source hash before applying the page entry.
Apply pre_ocr_rotation_clockwise_degrees to the original Poppler-rendered page before recognition; preserve source-coordinate transforms and previous OCR attempts.
Mal and Rajganj are already upright on all 41 pages. Their zero semantic rows cannot be explained by sideways orientation.
All 163 pages in the other seven documents need 90 degrees clockwise, including 16 Maynaguri order covers and one Matiali signature page. These 17 pages contain no ward table.
The page-level ocr_language=eng assertion covers the visibly English printed form and table content, not handwritten signatures.
limitations: This is an orientation, printed-language and page-content audit, not a transcription or a verification of any name, seat code, category, vote, or total.
Correct orientation does not resolve all semantic parsing failures, source shading, faint text, missing continuation headers, or incorrect constituency anchors.
Source observations are distinct from achieved OCR improvement; no OCR was performed by this audit task.
